text:
anna-sec: Security advisory: we've detected a malicious layer in a base image used by several CI pipelines (image: registry.redwood.internal/base/node-14:latest). It pulls a dropped script that exfiltrates env files to an external host. Immediate actions below.

pete-build: Ack. Which pipelines are affected?

anna-sec: Initial scanner matched image digest sha256:9f3b... and found a post-install script referencing hxxp://cdn.badmirror[.]net/payload.sh. We flagged builds in repos: web-frontend, telemetry-ingest, and billing-worker.

sec-bot: Automated detector sec-2026-049: flagged 18 recent builds that pulled the compromised digest. See alert id sec-2026-049.

maya-qa: Containment: I'll pause the vulnerable pipelines and kick off rebuilds using a known-good digest from our hardened images team. ETA 12m.

sam-registry: We're revoking the compromised tag and quarantining the layer in the registry. Also triggering a forced repull for images in pods. Adding the digest to the blocked list.

ops-oncall: We'll add a WAF egress rule to block outbound traffic to cdn.badmirror.net and related domains while we triage.

anna-sec: Action items: 1) Stop any running workloads using the digest. 2) Rotate any keys that were present in containers launched from the image in the last 48h. 3) Rebuild images from source using our verified base (base/node-14@sha256:111aaa...). 4) Audit registry and CI for any service accounts that pushed or modified base images.

pete-build: How should teams check if a build used the digest? command?

anna-sec: Run: `crane digest registry.redwood.internal/base/node-14:latest` or `kubectl get pods -o jsonpath='{..imageID}' | grep sha256:9f3b` to find running instances. Also `gcrane ls --digests registry.redwood.internal/base/node-14` for registry history. Don't paste keys in Slack.

sam-registry: We've blocked pushes from any non-maintainer principals to the base/ namespace and started a forensic pull of manifests and user activity. Found one suspicious CI agent (ci-deployer-7) that pulled the layer before it was quarantined.

maya-qa: Paused pipelines: web-frontend, telemetry-ingest, billing-worker. Triggered rebuilds against pinned digest and a rollback for staging.

anna-sec: Prioritize rotating any long-lived service account keys used by the CI agent ci-deployer-7 and any local machine tokens used to build/push images in the last 72h. Target high-risk rotations within 2 hours.

ops-oncall: Egress block applied to cdn.badmirror.net (2167801225). Registry quarantine created for sha256:9f3b... (2167801240).

sec-bot: Incident sec-2026-049 update: 18 builds paused, 3 running pods replaced with safe images, 1 suspicious CI agent flagged for key rotation.

pete-build: We'll add an image provenance check in CI (verify signatures and provenance) and fail builds that use unverified digests. Also enabling cosign verification on push.

maya-qa: Adding automated test to verify base image digest pinned in Dockerfile and fail if :latest is used.

anna-sec: Longer term: enforce required image signing for base namespaces, tighten registry roles, and add runtime detection for suspicious outbound requests from containers.

sam-registry: Notifying registry maintainers and opening ticket REG-912 to add immutable tags for production base images.

anna-sec: If you pulled that image locally, assume local envs with any secrets may be compromised and rotate accordingly. Upload any findings to the secure incident folder and tag sec-2026-049. We'll publish a post-incident summary after containment and audit. :lock:
